title: Sanhedrin
summary: The Sanhedrin was the leading Jewish council connected with religious and legal authority in Jerusalem.
background: In the New Testament, the council appears in trials, investigations, and opposition to Jesus and the apostles. It included influential leaders such as chief priests, elders, and scribes.
teachingHelp: When the council appears, help listeners see both the seriousness of formal opposition and God’s authority over human courts.
